render_rules.headlines: NEVER truncate or ellipsis a headline. No line-clamp/overflow-hidden on any title. Headlines wrap fully; if a headline exceeds its stage at the set size, scale type down until it fits. Ellipsised titles (e.g. “Generalized Marine…”) are an automatic QA fail.
render_rules.kickers: Every section renders exactly ONE kicker, from its authored kicker field, in one visual style (small caps, gold). No kicker-less headings; no duplicated kickers (current build prints “03 · THE PRODUCT” twice back-to-back and “OPERATING PLAN — CONSERVATIVE CASE” twice in one chapter — both FAIL). Nav bar Title Case vs in-page caps split is intentional — keep.
render_rules.clipping: No text element may clip at any container edge at any width ≥320px. Known instances: control-schematic callout labels and the Quanta founder-video caption both clip at the LEFT edge — fix at component level (label min-margins, no overflow:hidden on label boxes). Add a scripted horizontal-clip scan (element boundingRect vs container) at 1280/1440/2560 to the gate.
render_rules.headline_case: All section headlines use one Title Case serif style. All-caps headlines (current Quanta interstitial) are a FAIL; all-caps is reserved for kickers and stat-chip labels.
render_rules.no_reflow: Interactive state changes (card flips, hover expands, tab swaps) MUST NOT change document height. Reserve space for the taller state; crossfade/transform inside a fixed box. A +N px reflow at flip is a HARD FAIL.
render_rules.no_nested_scroll: No overflow:auto/scroll containers for content rows (pipeline, tables, boards) at 1280/1440/2560. Page scroll is fine; inner scrollbars are a HARD FAIL.
render_rules.all_caps: All-caps is reserved for kickers, eyebrows, and stat-chip labels only. Section headlines and card titles use Title Case.
render_rules.dead_air: No empty vertical band >200px inside a stage between title and first content block, or between composed media and its copy.
render_rules.chip_nowrap: Stat chips and gold-stat labels must not wrap mid-hyphen; use white-space: nowrap on chip values or allow soft wrap only at spaces.

global_render_rules: NO-REFLOW RULE: no scroll-triggered state change may alter document height — reserve space for the taller state and transition within it.
NO NESTED SCROLL: no inner scroll regions anywhere on the page; stages grow instead.
ALL-CAPS is reserved for kickers, eyebrows, and stat labels. Headings and titles render in Title Case or sentence case as authored.
DEAD-AIR BUDGET: no vertical empty band >200px inside a stage at 1280/1440 widths.
CHIP WRAP: stat/status chips never wrap mid-word or mid-hyphen — chips size to content with no-wrap.
CLIP SCAN: every labeled diagram and caption must pass the scripted clip scan at 1280/1440/2560 — includes the control schematic label column (v8 C1 close-out).
